seoTitle: Nevada School Calendar 2026-2027: Start Dates, Holidays, Breaks & District Calendars
seoDescription: Find Nevada school calendars for 2026-2027, including district start dates, Nevada Day, winter break, spring break, calendar PDFs, and Google Calendar downloads.
about:
Nevada public school calendars are approved by local school districts, so start dates, break windows, staff development days, parent-teacher conference days, contingency days, and year-round school schedules can vary by county and school type. The largest Nevada calendar on MySchoolDates is Clark County School District, which serves families across Las Vegas, Henderson, North Las Vegas, Boulder City, Mesquite, and other Clark County communities.

Families should check whether their school follows the traditional district calendar, a year-round calendar, or a specialized program schedule. Districtwide calendars are useful for first day, last day, holidays, Nevada Day, winter break, spring break, and contingency day planning, but school-specific events, athletics, testing windows, graduation schedules, magnet programs, and career and technical academies may be published separately.

Nevada calendar planning is often county-specific. Clark County families may compare Las Vegas-area traditional and year-round calendars, while northern Nevada families commonly search for Washoe County and Reno school-year dates. Nevada Day is a state-specific holiday that appears on many school calendars, and districts may also use staff development days, contingency days, or revised PDFs when board-approved calendars change.

faqs.a: Nevada school start dates vary by district and school type. Large districts such as Clark County School District often begin in August, but families should confirm the official first day on the district calendar.

faqs.q: Are Nevada school calendars the same statewide?
faqs.a: No. Nevada school calendars are set locally. First day, last day, holidays, professional development days, and contingency day rules can differ by district.

faqs.q: Are Nevada school calendars different by county?
faqs.a: Yes. Nevada school calendars are usually approved at the local district or county level, so Clark County, Washoe County, Douglas County, Carson City, and other districts may use different start dates, breaks, and staff days.

faqs.q: Where can I find the CCSD calendar?
faqs.a: Use the Clark County School District calendar page on MySchoolDates for CCSD start date, holidays, winter break, spring break, student calendar PDF, ICS download, and planning notes.

faqs.q: When is Nevada Day school holiday?
faqs.a: Nevada Day is observed in late October. District calendars may list Nevada Day or Nevada Day Observed, so families should confirm the exact no-school date on their local district calendar.

faqs.q: When is Nevada winter break in 2026?
faqs.a: Nevada winter break dates vary by district. Many school calendars place winter break in late December and early January, but families should check the official district calendar for exact dates.

faqs.q: When is Nevada spring break in 2027?
faqs.a: Nevada spring break dates are district-specific. Some districts schedule spring break in March, while others may use a different window based on the approved school calendar.

faqs.q: Do Nevada districts use contingency days?
faqs.a: Some Nevada district calendars list contingency days or make-up days. Families should avoid treating these as guaranteed vacation days until the district confirms they are not needed.

faqs.q: How many school days are required in Nevada?
faqs.a: Nevada districts must meet state instructional-time requirements, but family-facing calendars usually focus on student attendance days, holidays, staff days, and make-up day rules. Use the official district calendar for the student schedule.

faqs.q: Can I download a Nevada school calendar PDF?
faqs.a: District pages on MySchoolDates include official PDF links when available. For statewide planning, choose the district page first because Nevada does not publish one statewide school calendar PDF.

faqs.q: Can I add a Nevada school calendar to Google Calendar?
faqs.a: Yes. District pages on MySchoolDates include calendar download options when available, including ICS files that can be imported into Google Calendar, Apple Calendar, or Outlook.
